WITH state_counts AS (
  SELECT state_county_province, COUNT(*) AS customer_count
  FROM Customers
  GROUP BY state_county_province
),
state_shares AS (
  SELECT state_county_province,
         customer_count,
         1.0 * customer_count / SUM(customer_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM state_counts
),
summary AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share
  FROM state_shares
)
SELECT SUM(ss.customer_count) AS combined_account_base,
       AVG(ss.share) AS average_share,
       AVG(ss.share - s.average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM state_shares ss
CROSS JOIN summary s
WHERE ss.share > s.average_share;
